item.title: 米国債上昇、ベッセント長官とウォーシュ議長の発言に手掛かり探る
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 24日の米国債は上昇。今週は市場参加者にとって重要な週となる可能性がある。ベッセント米財務長官と米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）のウォーシュ議長の発言が、今後の利回りの方向を左右しそうだ。

米国債利回りは幅広い年限で低下。10年債利回りは3ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp=0.01%）低下の4.71%、30年債利回りも同程度低下し5.24%となった。先週は30年債利回りが一時20年ぶりの高水準付近となったほか、米財務省が国債買い戻しの拡大を明らかにし、荒い値動きが見られた。

最大の焦点は、ベッセント財務長官が次にどのような措置を講じるかだ。同長官は前週、長期債の買い戻しを増やす計画を示して市場を驚かせた。債券保有者は現在、巨額の米財政赤字に対するベッセント氏の対応策について、具体的な内容を求めている。

ウォーシュ議長の発言にも投資家の注目が集まっている。カンザスシティー連銀が主催するジャクソンホール経済政策シンポジウム（ジャクソンホール会合）で28日に基調講演を行う予定だ。インフレ率が目標を大幅に上回る中、長期金利の抑制を図りたいベッセント氏の介入を踏まえ、FRBがインフレ抑制にどう取り組むのか、説明を求められることになる。

BNYのシニア・マーケット・ストラテジスト、ジェフ・ユー氏は「市場は今週、ウォーシュ氏がFRB議長として初めて臨むジャクソンホールでの講演を見据えた展開となるだろう」と述べ、「長期債がなお不安定な状況にある中、投資家は財務省の措置にFRBがどう対応するのかを知りたがっている」と続けた。

26日に発表される7月の米個人消費支出（PCE）価格指数も重要になると、ユー氏は指摘。ブルームバーグが調査したエコノミストは、前年比の伸びが前月の3.7%から3.6%へと小幅に鈍化すると予想している。コア指数は3.3%で横ばいとなる見通しだ。

ウォーシュ氏自身は5月の就任以降、金利の先行きについてほとんど手掛かりを示していない。前回の連邦公開市場委員会（FOMC）金融政策会合後の同氏の発言が大規模な売りを誘ったこともあり、28日に予定される発言を巡って、市場は神経質になっている。

BEIJING: Floods and landslides triggered by Typhoon Narra battered northern Vietnam and China's southern region of Guangxi, as accompanying heavy rains damaged infrastructure and crops. Rising floodwaters prompted China to relocate about 54,000 people, including 8,087 moved to emergency shelters, state broadcaster CCTV said. Days of heavy rain in northern Vietnam brought by Narra killed one and displaced more than 4,300 households. Narra lingered over the Beibu Gulf, also known as the Gulf of Tonkin, but weather officials said it would not make landfall, and instead bring downpours in the north.

Vietnam's mountainous provinces of Lang Son and Cao Bang received between 236mm and 300mm of rain in the 24 hours to Monday (Aug 24) morning, triggering floods and landslides.

Floods also affected Vietnam's Quang Ninh, home to the UNESCO World Heritage site of Ha Long Bay, inundating parts of the city and disrupting tourism, fishing and transport. The typhoon disrupted daily school and office activities, and snapped power links to nearly 55,000 families, authorities said, while destroying more than 10,000ha of rice and other crops. In China, the waters of 15 rivers rose beyond warning levels at monitoring stations. Brown floodwaters engulfed parts of Chongzuo city in CCTV video, submerging roads and clusters of low-rise structures. Chinese rescuers in rubber boots waded through knee-deep water, with some using boats to evacuate stranded residents. Torrential rain is forecast for Guangxi, Guangdong, Hainan and Fujian in downpours expected to last through Wednesday, CCTV said.

Source: Reuters/rl

item.title: 穀物輸送船への攻撃停止、ロシアは合意の用意ない＝ゼレンスキー氏
item.description: [キーウ ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[キーウ ２４日 ロイター] -  ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、黒海で農産物を輸送する船舶への攻撃停止について、ロシアには「合意する用意がない」と述べた。ロシアは国内の製油所やパイプラインへの攻撃停止も合意に含めるよう求めていると指摘した。

ゼレンスキー氏は、２３日に公表が許可された記者団への発言で「一部の首脳に対し、各国の船舶を使ってウクライナの港から食料を輸送するよう提案した。ロシア産農産物を輸送しに来る船舶は攻撃しないとも伝えた」と述べた。

一方、ロシア側は、ウクライナがロシアのエネルギー施設への攻撃を停止すれば、ウクライナの穀物輸送回廊への攻撃をやめるという相互措置を求めているという。

ゼレンスキー氏は「（ロシアにとって）問題なのは穀物ではなく、エネルギー部門だ。しかし、この二つを同列に扱うことはできない」と述べた。

また、ウクライナがロシアの製油所や燃料輸送への攻撃を停止するには、ロシアもウクライナのエネルギーシステムへの攻撃を停止する必要があるとした。

item.title: TotalEnergies profitably moving heavily discounted oil through Strait of Hormuz, says CEO
item.description: French oil major TotalEnergies is profitably moving oil through the Strait of Hormuz, with higher transport costs more than offset by steep discounts from crude producers, its CEO said at a Norwegian energy conference on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Nora Buli, Nerijus Adomaitis
item.content:encoded: French oil major TotalEnergies (TTEF.PA) is profitably moving oil through the Strait of Hormuz, with higher transport costs more than offset by steep discounts from crude producers, its CEO said at a Norwegian energy conference on Monday. "We are today probably the largest trader of oil from Iraq or from Qatar ... and I can tell you that today crude oil is moving through the Strait of Hormuz very quietly, not publicly," said CEO Patrick Pouyanne. The Strait of Hormuz, previously a key transit route for a fifth of global oil and LNG supplies, has been paralysed during the U.S. and Israeli war with Iran owing to threats of bombing and mines. Pouyanne and others have called for investment in [USN:L6N42V108 TEXT:"alternative routes"] for oil to leave the Middle East, but the TotalEnergies boss said on Monday that the route remains profitable for those who can find ship owners willing to cross the strait. MIDDLE EAST OIL DISCOUNTED TO $30 BELOW BRENT "Crude oil is sold to you at $50, $60 per barrel, not the Brent price, because the producers are desperate to push their oil into the market," Pouyanne said. Brent crude futures were above $90 a barrel on Monday. "It costs more or less $20 million to move a VLCC (very large crude carrier) through Hormuz and come back ... divided by 2 million barrels of oil, that's an extra $10 a barrel," the CEO added. The same was not true for refined oil products because of smaller capacity of those ships, resulting in an unsustainable $50 a barrel surcharge for transport. "That's why you don't have a single tanker of products moving out of Hormuz ... So you have today a lack of oil products. That's why you have a bearish crude oil market and a very bullish products market, which is very strange," Pouyanne said. ALTERNATIVE EXPORT ROUTES STILL NEEDED TotalEnergies still plans to invest in alternative routes. "We will become partners of the pipeline moving from Baghdad to Syria, but I will also invest in Abu Dhabi, in doubling the Fujairah pipeline," Pouyanne said. The existing Abu Dhabi Crude Oil Pipeline, also known as the Habshan-Fujairah pipeline, can carry up to 1.8 million barrels per day and has proved crucial as the United Arab Emirates seeks to maximise exports from the Gulf of Oman coast, just outside Hormuz. The UAE hopes to [USN:L6N41S0IK TEXT:"double"] that export capacity by next year.

SAO PAULO, Aug 24 (Reuters) – Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro are in a technical tie in a potential runoff ahead of October’s presidential election, a Nexus poll commissioned by lender BTG Pactual showed on Monday.

• In a simulated second-round runoff, Lula would receive 46% of voter support compared with 45% for Bolsonaro.

• An August 17 poll had Lula leading Bolsonaro 47%-44%.

Show Full Article

• In a first-round scenario, Lula would lead with 41% of the votes, followed by Bolsonaro (37%), Ronaldo Caiado (5%), Renan Santos (3%) and Romeu Zema (3%).

• The previous poll showed Lula at 41% and Bolsonaro at 36% in the first round.

• If no candidate wins more than 50% of valid votes in the first round, the two frontrunners advance to a runoff.

• Nexus surveyed 2,006 people between August 21-23; margin of error 2 percentage points.

(Reporting by Isabel Teles; Editing by Gabriel Araujo)

ZANDVOORT, Netherlands, Aug 24 : McLaren team boss Andrea Stella says Lando Norris is showing more self-confidence and being rewarded with his results. The reigning Formula One champion won Sunday's Dutch Grand Prix from pole position, his second successive victory and career 13th, but he had to earn it by passing Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli after losing the lead at a restart. The Briton is still 83 points off the lead but whittling away at the deficit.  "I would say that definitely he is now expressing a higher level of assertiveness," Stella told reporters at Zandvoort.

"The manoeuvre to pass Antonelli I think is a really good demonstration of that. He is demonstrating more self-confidence. "This is interesting and I quite like it, sometimes it is not demonstrated by being the most aggressive. Sometimes you are self-confident when you think like 'you know what, I'm not going to have a fight now because I may lose in this fight. It's a very long race, see you at the end'," Stella said that meant having the confidence to back off, while having faith in being able to come through in the long run. He pointed out that in Hungary and the Netherlands, Norris had lost the pole advantage but not his confidence. "I think assertiveness and confidence are probably the two characteristics that he has improved the most from a non-technical, non-operational point of view," added Stella. Norris has said the new generation of cars are difficult to drive and he has had to adapt his style to accommodate that. He also gave himself plenty of credit for Sunday's win, saying a driver could still make the difference. Stella agreed the Briton was driving like a champion and constantly improving, a process that started early in 2025 when "something clicked". "I think this approach has led Lando to continuous improvements. It's almost like I see Lando stronger and stronger race by race." Australian teammate Oscar Piastri has meanwhile gone a year since he last won a race, from pole at Zandvoort last August. Piastri finished sixth on Sunday, 32 seconds behind Norris and hampered by a slow pitstop that cost him a place on a frustrating afternoon. Stella said the result was not a fair reflection of Piastri's competitiveness through the sprint weekend.

Source: Reuters

item.title: イラン産原油、中国向け供給は既にほぼ途絶－通貨リアルは過去最安値
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： イランのアジア向け原油出荷は、既にほぼ途絶えている。米国はイランとその貿易相手国を孤立させる新たな措置を近く発表する予定だが、発表を前にイラン産原油のアジア向け価格は数年ぶりの高水準となっている。

また、イランの通貨リアルの取引データを追跡するウェブサイト、ボンバストによると、24日の非公式市場でリアルは1ドル＝199万2000リアルと過去最安値を付けた。トランプ米大統領が先週、「いかなる国に対してもこれまで実施されたことのない、最も強力な経済作戦を発表する！」と表明して以降の下落率は4.5%に達した。

非公式取引のデータを収集するもう一つのウェブサイト、TGJUでは23日にリアルは一時1ドル＝200万リアルの節目を割り込んだ。ただ、終値ではやや持ち直した。

イランが輸出する原油の大半は、中国の民間製油会社が購入してきた。だが、ここ数週間はアジアで買い入れが可能なイラン産原油の供給がほぼなくなり、提示価格は世界の原油指標に対してディスカウントから、1バレル当たり4ドル前後のプレミアムへと転じたという。交渉に関与するトレーダーが、匿名を条件に明らかにした。

この供給途絶は、米国の海上封鎖が功を奏している部分が大きい。原油を積載したイランの船舶はペルシャ湾内に閉じ込められ、空荷の船舶は湾外で足止めされている。

調査会社ケプラーによると、その結果、中国などアジアの買い手にとって主要な洋上保管・積み替え拠点であるマレー半島東方の海域にある原油は現在わずか4000万バレルに過ぎず、そのうち売却先が決まっていない原油はわずか400万バレルと見積もられている。これは超大型原油タンカー（VLCC）2隻分でしかない。

ベッセント米財務長官は24日、イランを経済的に完全に孤立させる「前例のない規模の」計画を発表する予定だ。中国の石油精製業者や関連企業に資金を提供する銀行が標的となる公算大きい。だが、原油価格が高騰し供給が底を突いている現在、米国の計画に伴う財政的・外交的コストも一段と注目されそうだ。

item.title: 原油再急騰が米株最大のリスク、エネルギー株でヘッジを－モルガンS
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： モルガン・スタンレーのマイケル・ウィルソン氏は、原油価格の再急騰が米国株にとって最大のリスクだとの見方を示し、ポートフォリオのリスクを低減する手段として、エネルギー株を活用するよう推奨している。

ウィルソン氏によると、原油価格がさらに上昇すれば債券利回りを押し上げ、米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）のウォーシュ議長は、インフレ率を目標に戻すために対応を迫られる可能性がある。

ウィルソン氏は「対応の中心は財務省よりもFRBになるだろう。最終的にFRBが対応することにほとんど疑いはないが、その前に市場がさらに不安定になる可能性が高い」と述べた。

米イランの戦闘再燃や和平協議の遅れを背景に、北海ブレント原油は7月初旬から約30%上昇し、1バレル＝93ドル前後で取引されている。米30年債利回りは先週、約20年ぶりの高水準近くまで上昇し、米財務省は国債の買い戻しを拡大する方針を発表した。

ウィルソン氏によると、原油価格が上昇した際の株式への打撃は、下落の際の恩恵より大きく、原油相場の安定が株式市場にとって一段と重要になっている。同氏は、原油価格が急騰するリスクへのヘッジとして、エネルギー株を活用することを推奨した。エクソンモービル・ホールディングスとシェブロンの株価は今年30%超上昇し、S&P500種株価指数の上昇率の2倍超となっている。

また、利益が安定し、利益率が高く、効率的な事業運営を行う「クオリティー株」を選好する姿勢も改めて示した。S&P500はクオリティー企業の比重が高く、7月に半導体株主導で相場が下落した際にも、より大幅な下落を免れたという。S&P500は21日、過去最高値を2%弱下回る水準で取引を終えた。

S&P500などの指数の構成も、ウィルソン氏が米国株を海外株より選好する理由の一つだ。同氏は、半導体株が短期的に再び相場の主導役となる可能性は低いとの見通しを示した。

item.title: Temu-owner PDD revenue misses estimates, profit falls on 'intense' China competition
item.description: Chinese e-commerce discounter PDD Holdings reported a fall in second-quarter profit on Monday and revenue that missed market estimates as fierce competition in China and mounting regulatory pressure overseas weighed on growth.
item.dc:creator: Harshita Varghese, Casey Hall
item.content:encoded: Chinese e-commerce discounter PDD Holdings (PDD.O) reported a fall in second-quarter profit on Monday and revenue that missed market estimates as fierce competition in China and mounting regulatory pressure overseas weighed on growth. The operator of Pinduoduo in China and Temu internationally said revenue rose 8% to 112.36 billion yuan ($15.7 billion) in the three months ended June 30, below analysts' average estimate of 116.35 billion yuan, according to LSEG data. Net income attributable to ordinary shareholders fell 12% to 27.2 billion yuan from a year earlier, but adjusted earnings per American Depositary Share of 19.33 yuan beat analysts' expectations. PDD shares were up 2.3% in early morning trading in New York. PDD competes with Alibaba's (9988.HK) Taobao and Tmall, JD.com (9618.HK) and ByteDance-owned Douyin through discounts, subsidies and incentives aimed at attracting consumers and merchants. However, weak consumer confidence, concerns over job security and a prolonged property downturn have kept shoppers cautious, fuelling a price war across China's e-commerce sector and squeezing margins. PDD executives told analysts on a post-earnings call that competition in the Chinese e-commerce market "remained intense", prompting further investments in platform governance. Consumer spending remained subdued even during this year's [USN:L1N42P06M TEXT:""618" shopping festival"], one of China's largest online sales events, despite weeks of promotions and discounts. PDD has stepped up spending on logistics and merchant support programmes to lower fulfilment costs and improve value for consumers, raising investor concerns that profitability could come under further pressure. REGULATORY PRESSURES IN US AND EUROPE Temu, meanwhile, faces increasing scrutiny in some of its largest overseas markets. The platform built its international business by shipping low-cost goods directly from Chinese suppliers to overseas consumers, but has been hit by U.S. tariffs on Chinese imports and the end of duty-free treatment for low-value parcels. Higher shipping and compliance costs have forced some merchants to raise prices, potentially dampening demand among price-sensitive shoppers in the U.S. and Europe. Low-value e-commerce goods have also attracted scrutiny, with [USN:L1N4260BB TEXT:"shipments declining"] in recent months as changes to trade rules and tariffs disrupted cross-border sales. "We find ourselves at a unique intersection of global trade constantly navigating diverse international regulatory frameworks," said PDD's co-CEO Chen Lei. In Europe, policymakers have stepped up efforts to curb the influx of inexpensive goods from China through platforms including Temu, Shein and Alibaba's AliExpress. The European Union's [USN:L6N42Y0OM TEXT:"new fee"] imposed in July on small parcels imported directly from China is set to increase costs for sellers and consumers alike, industry analysts say. "In the short term, cross-border orders in the affected markets will face slower fulfilment efficiency and higher costs which will have a considerable impact on those parts of our business," Chen said. The added costs threaten to erode Temu's price advantage and could make it harder for the company to sustain the rapid international growth that has helped fuel investor enthusiasm for PDD, analysts say. ($1 = 6.7225 Chinese yuan renminbi)

item.title: TSX flat as investors weigh US tariffs, await Iran sanctions details
item.description: Canada's commodity-heavy stock index was little changed on Monday, as investors weighed new U.S. tariffs on Canadian goods and awaited details on Washington's threatened sanctions against Iran.
item.dc:creator: Sudeshna Ghoshal
item.content:encoded: Canada's commodity-heavy stock index was little changed on Monday, as investors weighed new U.S. tariffs on Canadian goods and awaited details on Washington's threatened sanctions against Iran. The S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) was flat at 36,615.45 points by 10:00 a.m. ET. The U.S. imposed [USN:L1N44I0GP TEXT:"50% tariffs"] on some Canadian goods on Saturday, after the two neighbors failed to reach a trade deal. President Donald Trump also said on Monday that U.S. tariffs on all cars and trucks, automotive parts and steel [USN:L6N44L0PR TEXT:"will be increased"] to 50% starting January 1, 2027. Materials sector (.GSPTTMT) , which includes metal mining shares, rose 1.1%, leading gains on the main index as gold hit a three-month high against a subdued dollar, while investors awaited U.S. inflation data and remarks from Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh this week for clues on the interest-rate outlook. I-80 Gold Corp , Seabridge Gold (SEA.TO) and NovaGold Resources (NG.TO) were up more than 4% each, leading sectoral gains. "Gold's having a good move ... I think you're seeing more of a move back towards the commodities," said Greg Taylor, chief investment officer at PenderFund Capital Management. The heavyweight energy sector (.SPTTEN) was the biggest drag on the index, falling 0.9% as oil prices slipped, with investors taking profits ahead of expected new U.S. sanctions on Iran. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who is [USN:L1N44K02A TEXT:"set to hold"] a press conference at 2 p.m. EDT (1800 GMT), has threatened to roll out "the greatest financial offensive ever" against Iran. Trump has also threatened sanctions on Iran's trading partners. Five of the TSX's 10 major sectors traded higher.

MUMBAI, Aug 24 : India will launch tokenised corporate bonds next month, as it tests the use of blockchain technology to enable instant settlement of bond transactions, three sources with direct knowledge of the matter said on Monday. The notes, to be issued for the first time by state-owned power financier REC, would place India alongside markets such as Europe and Hong Kong in using the technology for issuance and settlement. Tokenised bonds are securities whose ownership, issuance, trading and settlement are recorded digitally on a blockchain or distributed ledger, allowing transactions to be completed almost instantly. India's markets regulator and central bank are working together on pushing the technology, according to the sources, who spoke on the condition of anonymity as the discussions are ongoing and confidential.

REC will issue tokenised bonds worth less than 5 billion rupees ($57 million) in the offering, the sources said. The offering is expected to be unveiled at an annual financial technology event in Mumbai next month, one of the sources said. India's central bank digital currency will be used to buy the tokenised bonds, one of the sources said. Details about the issuer, timeline and framework have not been reported previously. "The offering would be made available to only a select group of investors at the pilot stage," one of the sources said. Reuters could not ascertain the names of the investors. The central bank, markets regulator and REC did not respond to emails seeking comment. NEW BOND FRAMEWORK To tap the bonds, investors will need to access two digital accounts: a wholesale digital currency wallet provided by a bank, and a new electronic securities wallet, the sources said. Indian depositories are developing an e-wallet, a first of its kind, called DEMAT 2.0, which will record bond holdings on a distributed ledger technology chain. "Subsequent trades can take place only between participants that hold both compatible CBDC and securities wallets," one of the sources said. The bonds will have an initial three-month lock-in and exchanges are expected to develop a secondary market for the tokenised bonds by December, one of the sources said. The securities will not be traded on the conventional electronic book provider platform, the sources said. Depositories NSDL and CDSL did not immediately respond to Reuters queries.

item.title: 台湾検察、ＡＩサーバー中国不正輸出でエヌビディア現地社員ら起訴
item.description:
Wen-Yee Lee Ben Blanchard
［台北 ２４日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Wen-Yee Lee　Ben Blanchard

［台北 　２４日　ロイター］ - 台湾の検察当局は２４日、人工知能（ＡＩ）サーバーを中国に不正輸出することに関与したとして、エヌビディアやスーパーマイクロの従業員を含む９人を起訴したと発表した。

基隆の検察当局によると、エヌビディア台湾法人の従業員１人とスーパーマイクロ台湾法人の従業員２人を含む８人が、高性能ＡＩサーバーの不正輸出に関連して背任および文書偽造の罪で起訴されたと明らかにした。１人は、関与した販売代理店から資金を不正に引き出したとされる関連事件で起訴された。

検察当局は今年、米国の輸出規制の対象となっているエヌビディア製半導体を搭載したサーバーの不正輸出の疑いについて捜査していた。スーパーマイクロが「Ｂ３００」サーバー１３０台を受注。偽造文書では台湾のレンタルサーバー施設に設置され使用されるとしていたが、１３０台のサーバーのうち７４台は中国へ直接、またはインドネシア、日本、香港を経由して輸出された。残り５６台は日本企業向けとしていたが、台湾の税関が不正を発見し、輸出を差し止めたという。

検察当局は、被告らはエヌビディアとスーパーマイクロが輸出に関して「厳格な内部統制手続き」を設けていることを「完全に認識」していたとした上で、「莫大な利益のためにさまざまなレベルで互いに結託して高性能サーバーを不正に輸出し、企業のコンプライアンス（法令順守）費用を増大させ、わが国の国際的なイメージを著しく損なった」と指摘した。

item.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq slip as Iran tensions test markets in high-stakes week
item.description: The S&P 500 and the tech-heavy Nasdaq slipped on Monday as investors weighed the potential fallout from the U.S. pledge of an "economic D-Day" against Iran while awaiting AI giant Nvidia's results and a key inflation report later this week.
item.dc:creator: Purvi Agarwal, Niket Nishant
item.content:encoded: The S&P 500 and the tech-heavy Nasdaq slipped on Monday as investors weighed the potential fallout from the U.S. pledge of an "economic D-Day" against Iran while awaiting AI giant Nvidia's results and a key inflation report later this week. The moves mark a sober start to a pivotal week that may determine whether equities can shrug off a flare-up in Middle East tensions and worries tied to a tense bond market, which have interrupted their rally. The U.S. has said it could [USN:L6N44K07T TEXT:"roll out"] economic sanctions targeting Iran's trade partners, in what it called "the greatest financial offensive ever." Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who warned of an "economic D-Day" in an opinion piece published in the Financial Times, is scheduled to hold a press conference in the afternoon. EYES ON WARSH'S JACKSON HOLE SPEECH Concerns over surging energy prices and ballooning government debt had pushed U.S. Treasury yields higher last week, with the 30-year yield touching a 19-year peak before the Treasury announced support measures. Higher yields hammered growth-oriented technology stocks, causing Wall Street's three main indexes to post losses last week. Bessent could tap Treasury's near $1 trillion General Account to help fund bond buybacks, instead of issuing short-term bills, CNBC reported on Monday. The 30-year U.S. Treasury yield declined slightly but remained above the 5% threshold. The turbulence has sharpened focus on Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's speech at the Jackson Hole symposium later this week, where investors will parse his remarks for clues on policymakers' reading of the Treasury's rescue efforts and the latest economic data. Quarterly results from Nvidia (NVDA.O) , the world's most valuable company, are expected to be another key catalyst for markets. Any sign of slowing growth could reignite concerns over stretched valuations and how far the AI-driven rally could run. "Chips have become a frothy space. I just don't know what good news hasn't already been priced in," said Marta Norton, chief investment strategist at retirement and wealth services provider Empower. "It doesn't necessarily mean that the fundamentals are challenged. You can have a great company, but that doesn't necessarily make it a great investment at a given point in time." Trading in megacaps was mixed on Monday. While Apple (AAPL.O) and Amazon.com (AMZN.O) each gained less than a percent, Nvidia lost 2.44%. The S&P 500 Information Technology sector (.SPLRCT) , down 1.11%, led sectoral losses. Healthcare stocks (.SPXHC) , [USN:L4N4400DW TEXT:"a favorite bet"] for investors seeking diversification beyond AI, also fell 0.57%. Most chipmakers, too, declined. Marvell Technology (MRVL.O) and Micron Technology (MU.O) fell more than 6% each. Sandisk (SNDK.O) slid 10.62%. U.S.-listed shares of Alibaba (9988.HK) , slipped 1.24% after the Chinese e-commerce giant launched [USN:L6N44L021 TEXT:"a $10.2 billion share sale"] to fund its AI ambitions. At 09:45 a.m. ET, the S&P 500 (.SPX) fell 20.77 points, or 0.27%, to 7,653.60. The Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) dropped 164.51 points, or 0.63%, to 26,015.94, while the blue-chip Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) rose 112.18 points, or 0.21%, to 53,389.19. U.S.-listed shares of PDD (PDD.O) rose 0.44% after the Temu owner reported [USN:L4N44L0PX TEXT:"an 8% rise"] in second-quarter revenue. Markets will also monitor the Personal Consumption Expenditures report, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, due on Wednesday for clues on how the Iran conflict is feeding into broader economic conditions. Traders have fully priced in one 25-basis-point interest rate hike by the end of 2026, according to LSEG data. A benign inflation report earlier this month, however, has reduced the chances of an immediate increase. Advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 1.15-to-1 ratio on the NYSE. On the Nasdaq, declining issues outnumbered advancers by a 1.51-to-1 ratio. The S&P 500 posted nine new 52-week highs and two new lows, while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 31 new highs and 36 new lows.

JOHANNESBURG, Aug 24 : Captain Siya Kolisi has been named in the South Africa side to take on New Zealand in the second test in Cape Town on Saturday, but only if he passes a fitness test later in the week, while flyhalf Sacha Feinberg-Mngomezulu has been dropped. • Kolisi will take the place of Paul de Villiers if he makes it through the week’s training after being omitted from the team beaten 33-16 by the All Blacks in the first test in Johannesburg. If he does not, De Villiers will keep his place, coach Rassie Erasmus said on Monday. • The experienced halfback pairing of Handre Pollard and Cobus Reinach replace Feinberg-Mngomezulu, who was guilty of key handling errors, and the injured Grant Williams. • Winger Cheslin Kolbe is also out with what Erasmus termed a niggle and will be replaced by Ethan Hooker, which means Kurt-Lee Arendse switches from the left to right wing.

item.title: Trump's frustrations drove order limiting child vaccinations, but MAHA wants more
item.description: President Donald Trump's frustration that his administration was not doing enough to address what he considers a likely contributor to autism drove a U.S. executive order this month that cut back the number of childhood vaccinations, administration officials told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Yasmeen Abutaleb, Bo Erickson
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump's frustration that his administration was not doing enough to address what he considers a likely contributor to autism drove a U.S. executive order this month that [USN:FWN4471RZ TEXT:"cut back the number of childhood vaccinations"], administration officials told Reuters. These five current and former officials privately say the order alone does not substantially change U.S. vaccine policy and will not satisfy Trump’s demands or Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s “Make America Healthy Again” political base. Instead, Kennedy and his allies are focused on a series of studies that the health secretary kicked off last year examining what they say are the dangers of vaccines, including a potential link with autism. Medical experts and scientists say such concerns have been thoroughly refuted by studies examining millions of children over many years. “No one wants to see this get done with an executive order. Robert F. Kennedy Jr. knows that will not be a lasting change if it’s not backed up by credible science,” said Del Bigtree, one of Kennedy’s longtime allies and chief executive officer of Informed Consent Action Network, a group that has continually questioned vaccine safety. “This is only the beginning of a process that had to happen.” The White House and the Department of Health and Human Services declined to comment on the specifics of what led to the executive order. White House spokesman Kush Desai said in a statement that Trump was responding to “countless parents (who) have had their questions and concerns about America’s childhood vaccine schedule ignored if not outright mocked.” HHS spokeswoman Grace Davis Jamison confirmed the research studies under way at the agency. “We are pursuing dozens of studies and analyses using some of the nation’s largest health datasets to uncover the root causes of America’s chronic disease epidemic,” Jamison said in a statement. EXPERTS WARN OF CONFUSION Leading medical groups say the Trump order will increase confusion and vaccine hesitancy among U.S. families and expose more children to preventable diseases. They fear that Kennedy’s push for vaccine safety studies is directed toward a predetermined conclusion that the shots are more dangerous than the illnesses they prevent. Trump’s vaccine order calls for reducing the federal childhood inoculation schedule to 11 immunizations from 17 and for separating the measles, mumps and rubella (MMR) vaccine into three separate shots — a feat [USN:L1N44810Z TEXT:"pharmaceutical companies said could take years"]. It also directs the Justice Department to challenge state vaccination requirements for children to attend school. Kennedy [USN:L8N3Y61FI TEXT:"unveiled a similarly whittled-down"] immunization schedule in January that circumvented the normal government process for making changes to vaccine policy. A federal judge in March [USN:L1N3ZF00J TEXT:"blocked the changes,"] saying that health regulators had acted unlawfully to carry out the health secretary’s agenda. The administration is still bound by that ruling, which it is appealing. BIG PROMISES, GROWING FRUSTRATION Kennedy, an influential promoter of anti-vaccine views for decades, promised an ambitious agenda as Trump’s top health official. Soon after taking office in early 2025, he said his department would find the causes behind rising U.S. rates of autism and re-examine the safety of childhood vaccines. But Kennedy’s self-imposed deadlines on autism answers, first in September of that year, then in March 2026, came and went with no new revelations. In recent months, Trump has pressed Kennedy to deliver on his promises regarding autism in meetings at the Oval Office and in frequent phone calls. That pressure has come even as the president’s political advisers urged the health secretary early this year not to talk publicly about vaccines ahead of November’s midterm elections — a request Kennedy complied with. But Trump has remained fixated on reducing the number of vaccinations American children receive, according to the five current and former officials. In addition, Trump and Kennedy have spoken extensively about trying to find treatments and a “cure” for autism, according to the officials. The private tensions came to the fore during a July 31 televised cabinet meeting at Camp David. Trump asked Kennedy: “How are you doing on the autism research?” Kennedy replied: “We will have an answer for you.” Trump’s public questioning of Kennedy signaled to White House and health department officials that the president wanted to see immediate action, according to three senior administration officials. The [USN:FWN4471RZ TEXT:"executive order Trump announced on vaccines"] was quickly cobbled together this summer, one of the officials said. There has been a “tide shift” on discussing vaccines since the cabinet meeting, one of the officials said. “Trump and Kennedy are more synced up than they have been all year.” The studies Kennedy is overseeing examine whether the MMR vaccine produces unintended changes in the immune system, which scientists have refuted; whether autism diagnoses are linked to childhood vaccinations; a potential link between vaccines and autoimmune diseases; and the impact of thimerosal, which was removed from childhood vaccines more than two decades ago, among other studies. The work mostly relies on federal health databases that experts have warned can be misused and misinterpreted if not analyzed properly. The work is expected to take months if not longer, adding to Trump’s frustration, according to two of the officials.

item.title: Exxon turns to automated drilling in the Permian in push for higher oil output
item.description: In rural west Texas where oil rigs and pump jacks dot the sparse flat landscape, an ExxonMobil contractor sits in a small office on a drilling rig, using controls on a screen to operate robotic machinery and move tall steel pipes weighing roughly 2,000 pounds.
item.dc:creator: Sheila Dang
item.content:encoded: In rural west Texas where oil rigs and pump jacks dot the sparse flat landscape, an ExxonMobil (XOM.N) contractor sits in a small office on a drilling rig, using controls on a screen to operate robotic machinery and move tall steel pipes weighing roughly 2,000 pounds. This work would usually require human overseers standing on the rig floor, the most common location for accidents on a rig. Exxon, the largest oil producer by volume in the U.S., operates more than 30 drilling rigs in the Permian Basin, two of which are automated rigs with robotic equipment. By 2028, the company aims to transition half of its fleet to automated rigs to reduce the need for workers to perform potentially dangerous work and increase efficiency to drill wells faster, an executive told Reuters. The Permian Basin in Texas and New Mexico, the biggest U.S. oilfield, revolutionized energy markets two decades ago when development of the shale basin turned the U.S. into one of the leading oil-producing countries. But the relatively quick decline rate of shale wells has prompted drillers to develop more technologies to extract the oil. Some in the industry are also concerned about when the Permian's production could begin to decline. Exxon plans to [USN:L4N3XF0WI TEXT:"grow its Permian production"] by almost 40% to 2.5 million barrels of oil equivalent per day by 2030. By contrast, rival oil major Chevron plans to hold production steady at about 1 million boepd, focusing instead on free cash flow. The automated drilling rigs are part of a combination of technologies and strategies Exxon is using to boost production, said Bart Cahir, Exxon's senior vice president of unconventionals, in an interview on the rig. "When we take people off the rig floor, those same individuals are now able to think ahead and plan for the next operation and that combination gives us efficiency," he said. "This is the productivity play." The company installed its first automated rig, supplied by drilling contractor Helmerich & Payne (HP.N) , last year. It drilled two miles horizontally underground in a little over six days, the third fastest time in Exxon's history. Exxon's use of automated rigs in the Permian and its goal of expanding the fleet has not been previously reported. REDUCING RISK AND DRILLING MORE On one of Exxon's automated rigs in Midland, a gate surrounds the drilling floor with a sign reading "Red Zone: Restricted Area." A drawing of the Grim Reaper illustrates the risk that workers face around heavy equipment and pressurized systems. Where workers would usually help move columns of drill pipe over two stories tall, robotic arms now position the pipes and connect them to a drill string. This allows drilling to continue deeper into the wellbore. Employees on the rig communicate with Exxon's central operations team in Houston to determine the precise movements the robotic system should make. Removing workers from the so-called Red Zones allows them to focus on other operations on the rig and reduces variability in the work, meaning more feet per day can be drilled, Cahir said. "In the history of well drilling activity, about a third of significant injuries that occur happen on the rig floor," he said. "By getting people out of that higher risk area, we're essentially eliminating that risk." Exxon plans to expand automated rigs to a quarter of the fleet next year and then half of the fleet by 2028, Cahir said. Exxon is also developing a suite of more than 40 technologies to double its oil recovery from the Permian by the early 2030s. The shale industry typically extracts just 10% of the oil in the ground due to the tight, compacted rock.

item.title: ウクライナ大統領「和平望むが降伏せず」、独立記念日で演説
item.description: [キーウ ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[キーウ ２４日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は２４日、独立記念日の演説で、同国は和平を望んでいるものの、どのような代償を払ってでもロシアに屈するつもりはないと強調した。

旧ソ連からの独立３５周年の記念行事には、バーナム英首相やコスタ欧州連合（ＥＵ）大統領ら各国首脳が参加した。

ゼレンスキー氏はメッセージアプリ「テレグラム」に投稿した動画で、「ウクライナは和平を強く望んでいるが、単に降伏するつもりはない」と述べた。

東部ドンバス地方のロシアの支配下にない地域を割譲するよう求めるロシアの要求について、受け入れてもロシアの侵略は止まらないとの認識を示した。「われわれはロシアに主導権を握らせない。ドンバスを手放しさえすれば全てがすぐに終わると欧州や世界全体を欺くことを許さない」と語った。

ゼレンスキー氏は、ウクライナを守る国民と兵士に敬意を表するとともに、戦争を止めるために必要な「あらゆるもの」を提供するよう支援国に求めた。

また、ロシアを交渉のテーブルに着かせ、制裁をさらに強化するよう要請した。ロシアに関して米国が抱く「あらゆる矛盾や懸念」が解消されることを期待すると述べた。

さらに「中国はもはや沈黙を続けてはならない」と訴えた。

item.title: パキスタン軍トップがテヘラン訪問、イラン指導部と会談へ 先週トランプ氏と電話会談
item.description:
Menna Alaa El-Din Kanishka Singh Asif Shahzad Ariba Shahid Mubasher Bukhari
［カイロ／イスラマバード ２４日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Menna Alaa El-Din 　Kanishka Singh　Asif Shahzad　Ariba Shahid　Mubasher Bukhari

［カイロ／イスラマバード　２４日　ロイター］ - 米イラン交渉の仲介役を務めるパキスタンのムニール陸軍元帥が２４日、イランの首都テヘランを訪問した。パキスタン側は今回の訪問について「地域の平和と安定を促進する」ための取り組みの一環で、ナクビ内相も同行していると説明した。トランプ米政権は２４日に対イラン経済制裁を発表することになっている。

ベセント米財務長官は米東部時間２４日午後１時（日本時間２５日午前２時）に記者会見を開く。ベセント氏は２３日、英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（ＦＴ）への寄稿で、イランに対し「史上最大の金融攻撃」を警告した。イランは経済戦争が続けば湾岸からの石油輸出を全面停止するとけん制した。

複数のパキスタン筋によると、ムニール氏は先週、トランプ米大統領と電話会談した。会談はトランプ氏からの申し出によるもので、パキスタンの影響力を利用してイランを交渉の席に復帰させることが趣旨だったという。

ムニール氏は２４日に最高指導者モジタバ・ハメネイ師に近い関係者らと面会する予定。協議は、米イランの緊張が焦点となるが、親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアへの攻撃や、パキスタン、トルコ、サウジアラビアの間で最近署名された防衛協定についても協議するとみられている。

item.title: 日本の超党派国会議員団が中国訪問、政治対話再開へ手探りの一歩
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 日本の超党派国会議員団は24日、4日間の日程で中国を訪問する。同国政府の反発を招いた昨年の高市早苗首相の台湾を巡る発言で日中関係の緊張が続く中、政治対話の再開へ手探りの一歩となる。

訪中計画を知る関係者によると、議員団は中国共産党中央対外連絡部の幹部との面会や経済界との交流を行う予定。

高市首相が昨年11月、台湾有事の際に自衛隊を派遣する可能性を示唆する発言をして以来、最大の貿易相手国である中国との関係は悪化している。高市氏の発言に対し中国は、日本が地域に軍事的脅威をもたらしていると非難し、自国民に日本への渡航を控えるよう呼びかけた。

中国政府はこのほか、民生・軍事の双方に利用可能なデュアルユース品目の輸出規制を強化した。

今回の訪中については、日本テレビなど報道各社が既に報じている。議員団には、自民党の橋本岳衆院議員や中道改革連合の伊佐進一衆院議員が含まれる。橋本氏は6月にもサプライチェーン関連のイベントに出席するため北京を訪れている。

伊佐氏はX（旧ツイッター）への投稿で、日中関係は「1972年以来の最悪の状態」にあるとし、政府間だけでなく、経済、文化、青少年の交流も「すべてがストップ」していると記した。

伊佐氏は、この状況が続くことは、日中双方にとって「決して国益に資するものではありません」と投稿。「両国の対話の窓口は必要ではないかと、同僚議員と議論する中で、訪中して意見交換を進めることを中国に提案することになりました」と説明した。

調査会社ユーラシア・グループの中国・北東アジア担当シニアアナリスト、ジェレミー・チャン氏は、「今回の議員団の訪問で日中関係が大きく改善するとは思わないが、中国の当局者が緊張緩和への道筋を慎重に探っていることは、間違いなく前向きな兆候だ」との見方を示した。

さらに「中国政府にとって日本への圧力が裏目に出ており、高市氏が少なくともあと1年は首相にとどまる可能性が高いことを暗に認めたとも考えられる」と語った。

item.title: 原油下落、米国の対イラン計画の詳細発表控え－ブレント93ドル付近
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 24日のエネルギー市場で原油先物は下落。市場は同日中に明らかになる米国によるイランを経済的に孤立させる計画の詳細を待っている。

北海ブレント原油は1バレル当たり93ドル付近に下落。過去2週間では13%程度上昇した。ウェスト・テキサス・インターミディエート（WTI）は同86ドル付近。ベッセント米財務長官は、イランに対する圧力を強化する計画の詳細を会見で明らかにする見通しで、CNBCとのインタビューでは、米同盟国に取り組みへの参加を強く促した。

シンガポール時間午後0時2分時点で、ブレント原油10月限は1.4%下げて1バレル＝93.09ドル。WTI10月限は1.6%安の同85.64ドル。

原油は今年、50%超上昇している。6カ月目に入った米国とイランの戦争により、原油や石油精製品の供給は世界的に滞っている。米国にとって、イラン産原油の最大の買い手である中国を標的にして反発を招くリスクを冒す以外に、イランに対する経済的圧力を実質的に強める手段があるのかは明確ではない。

ベッセント氏は英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（FT）への寄稿で、「イランを支える者たちは、同国の石油を購入し、輸送している」と述べ、「彼らは、イランを支え続けることがもたらす結果をよく考えるべきだ」と続けた。

原題：Oil Declines With US Economic Isolation Plan for Iran in Focus

item.title: 紅海のサウジ沖でタンカー被弾し火災、乗組員無事と英機関
item.description: ［カイロ ２４日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［カイロ　２４日　ロイター］ - 英海事機関（ＵＫＭＴＯ）は２４日、サウジアラビアの紅海側の港湾都市ヤンブーの西６３カイリの海上でタンカーが正体不明の飛翔体に被弾し、主甲板で火災が発生したと明らかにした。乗組員は全員無事で、環境への影響は報告されていないとした。

ヤンブーは紅海に面したサウジの主要な石油港。紅海は、イランが事実上封鎖するホルムズ海峡に代わるサウジ産原油の輸出ルートだが、先月、親イラン武装組織フーシ派が、サウジ関連船舶に対する封鎖を宣言した。

item.title: バーナム英首相、ＥＵとの緊密化に意欲 コスタ大統領に表明
item.description: [ロンドン ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ロンドン ２４日 ロイター] - 英首相府は２４日、バーナム首相が欧州連合（ＥＵ）のコスタ大統領に対し、英国はＥＵとの関係強化に向け、積極的に取り組む意向を伝えたと明らかにした。年内に開かれる英・ＥＵ首脳会議がその機会になるとの考えも示した。

バーナム氏は２３日夜、ウクライナを支援する「有志連合」会合の共同議長を務めるためキーウに向かう途中、コスタ氏と会談した。

英首相官邸の報道官によると、バーナム氏は、英国は欧州の同盟国との既存の防衛・安全保障協力を土台に、幅広い分野で連携強化を目指すと表明した。「ＥＵとの関係緊密化に向け、より大胆に取り組む必要がある」と伝えた。

同報道官は「これには英国と欧州の同盟国が既に築いている緊密な防衛・安全保障関係を基盤に、あらゆる分野で協力を深めることが含まれる」と説明した。

また両首脳は、年内に開かれる英・ＥＵ首脳会議がこうした取り組みを継続するための有効な場になるとの認識で一致した。

バーナム氏はキーウへの移動中、ルクセンブルクのフリーデン首相とも会談した。

両首脳は、カナダが支援する多国間の防衛支出金融機関「防衛・安全保障・レジリエンス銀行（ＤＳＲＢ）」や、英国、オランダ、フィンランド、ポーランドが立ち上げた「多国間防衛メカニズム」など、防衛支出を増やすためのさまざまな仕組みについて協議した。二つの枠組みが相互に補完し合う方法について話し合ったという。

item.title: Gulf bourses rise as Saudi index gains for fifth session
item.description: Saudi Arabia's stock market led gains among most Gulf bourses on Monday, as advances in financial, utilities and materials shares extended the previous session's rally despite weaker oil prices.
item.dc:creator: Md Hussain
item.content:encoded: Saudi Arabia's stock market led gains among most Gulf bourses on Monday, as advances in financial, utilities and materials shares extended the previous session's rally despite weaker oil prices. Oil prices [USN:L1N44K05C TEXT:"fell by more than $1"] a barrel as investors took profits ahead of an expected U.S. announcement on further sanctions on Iran, which could disrupt Middle East supplies. Iran dismissed the U.S. threat and said it would halt all oil exports from the Gulf if what it described as an economic war continued. Meanwhile, Pakistan's army chief Asim Munir [USN:L6N44K07T TEXT:"arrived in Iran on Monday for talks"], Iranian media reported. Pakistan said the visit was part of efforts to promote regional peace and stability. Saudi Arabia's benchmark index (.TASI) gained for a fifth consecutive session and closed 0.9% higher. Al Rajhi Bank (1120.SE) rose 1.7%, while petrochemical maker Saudi Basic Industries (2010.SE) added 1.6%. ACWA Power (2082.SE) advanced 2%. ACWA Power said on Sunday it had signed 15-year [USN:FWN44J005 TEXT:"storage-services agreements"] with Saudi Power Procurement Company for three 500-megawatt battery energy-storage projects in the kingdom. The company will hold an effective 34.9% stake in each project at financial close. Abu Dhabi's benchmark index (.FTFADGI) added 0.4%, helped by a 2.3% rise in First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB.AD) , the United Arab Emirates' largest lender, and a 2.5% gain in conglomerate Alpha Dhabi Holding (ALPHADHABI.AD) . Dubai's main index (.DFMGI) rose 0.2%, with most sectors advancing. Emaar Properties (EMAR.DU) added 1.3%, while toll-road operator Salik Company (SALIK.DU) gained 1.2%. Qatar's benchmark index (.QSI) climbed 0.5%, with most of its constituents in positive territory. Qatar National Bank (QNBK.QA) , the region's largest lender, rose 1.4%, while Mesaieed Petrochemical Holding (MPHC.QA) gained 2.1%. "Investors will closely watch the U.S. sanctions announcement and any improvement in shipping conditions in the Strait of Hormuz. Progress in talks could lift sentiment, said Daniel Takieddine, co-founder and chief executive of Sky Links Capital Group. "While persistent geopolitical risks remain a concern, strong local fundamentals continue to limit downside risks," he added. Outside the Gulf, Egypt's blue-chip index (.EGX30) eased 0.3%, with most shares ending lower. E-Finance (EFIH.CA) declined 2.6%, while Telecom Egypt (ETEL.CA) dropped 1.7%. SAUDI ARABIA (.TASI) up 0.9% to 11,174 DUBAI (.DFMGI) rose 0.2% to 5,866 ABU DHABI (.FTFADGI) gained 0.4% to 10,048 QATAR (.QSI) advanced 0.5% to 9,741 KUWAIT (.BKP) up 0.1% to 9,319 BAHRAIN (.BAX) added 0.1% to 1,947 OMAN (.MSX30) fell 0.1% to 7,501 EGYPT (.EGX30) down 0.3% to 55,165

item.title: 金が3カ月ぶり高値－米長期債買い戻し拡大受け、ドル安懸念広がる
item.description:
（ブルームバーグ）： 金は24日、一時1.2%上昇して1オンス＝4650ドルを上回り、5月半ば以来3カ月超ぶりの日中高値をつけた。米財務省による債券市場への大胆な介入を受け、ドル安への懸念が再燃し、投資家が代替資産に資金を振り向けている。
米財務省が長期国債の買い戻しを拡大すると発表し、国債利回りとドルが低下したことを背景に、金は先週、週ベースで3週連続上昇した。
借り入れコストを直接介入によって抑える米国の取り組みは、ドルへの信認を弱めるとの懸念につながり、相対的に他の投資先の魅力を高めている。金が2025年に65%上昇する一因となった、いわゆる「通貨価値の希薄化（ディベースメント）」を巡るテーマが、再び意識されている。ドル建てで取引される商品相場には、ドル安は追い風だ。
グローバルX
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 金は24日、一時1.2%上昇して1オンス＝4650ドルを上回り、5月半ば以来3カ月超ぶりの日中高値をつけた。米財務省による債券市場への大胆な介入を受け、ドル安への懸念が再燃し、投資家が代替資産に資金を振り向けている。

米財務省が長期国債の買い戻しを拡大すると発表し、国債利回りとドルが低下したことを背景に、金は先週、週ベースで3週連続上昇した。

借り入れコストを直接介入によって抑える米国の取り組みは、ドルへの信認を弱めるとの懸念につながり、相対的に他の投資先の魅力を高めている。金が2025年に65%上昇する一因となった、いわゆる「通貨価値の希薄化（ディベースメント）」を巡るテーマが、再び意識されている。ドル建てで取引される商品相場には、ドル安は追い風だ。

グローバルX ETFのアナリスト、ジャスティン・リン氏は「ディベースメントの見方を背景に、マクロ投資家の資金が貴金属へかなり大規模にシフトする余地があるとみている」と述べた。

ブルームバーグが追跡する金連動型上場投資信託（ETF）の保有量は先週、28トン超増と、1月以来の大幅な増加となった。1月は金相場が急騰し、1オンス＝5600ドル弱の過去最高値を付けた。華僑銀行（OCBC）のストラテジスト、クリストファー・ウォン氏は、金市場に参加する投資家の裾野が広がっていることを示す好ましい傾向だとしている。

ウォン氏は「上昇相場にはまだ継続する余地があるが、最近の急騰を踏まえれば、ある程度の持ち合いとなるのが健全だろう」と述べた。同氏は目先の主なリスクとして、実質金利やドルの再上昇を挙げた。

ブリッジウォーター・アソシエーツ創業者で資産家のレイ・ダリオ氏は21日、リンクトインへの投稿で、米国の債務危機に備えるため、投資家は債券の保有を減らし、資産の最大15%を金に振り向けるべきだとの考えを示した。

金はロンドン時間午前9時10分時点で、0.8%高の1オンス＝4638.84ドルで取引されている。銀は68.90ドルとほぼ横ばいで推移している。

item.title: 来週の日本国債入札、ベッセント長官に試練－米長期金利に影響も
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 来週実施される2回の日本国債入札が、米長期国債利回りの抑制を図るベッセント米財務長官の取り組みにとっての試練となり得る。

日本の財務省は9月1日に10年債、3日に30年債の入札を行う。世界各国の政府借り入れを巡り、投資家がこれまで以上に高い上乗せ金利を求めているさなかの入札となる。入札で需要の弱さが示されれば、米国債市場に波及する恐れもある。米30年国債利回りはすでに約20年ぶりの高水準付近にある。

国債残高の増大と市場のボラティリティー上昇に投資家が対応する中、米国と日本の債券市場の連動性はここ数年、一段と強まっている。

その一例として、日本の超長期債利回りが昨年急上昇した際、米国債市場にも影響が及んだ。米国の公的債務が40兆ドル（約6365兆円）を超え、借り入れコストも膨らむ中で、悪循環に陥る可能性があり、リスクは現在の方が大きいかもしれない。

野村ホールディングスのシニア金利ストラテジスト、アンドリュー・タイスハースト氏（シドニー在勤）は、「今後の日本国債入札を市場は非常に注意深く見守るだろう」と述べ、「入札が不調に終われば日本国債利回りは上昇し、それによって国内投資家にとって市場の魅力が高まり得る。その結果、米国債利回りにも一段の上昇圧力がかかるだろう」と予想した。

財政懸念が再燃し、ここ数週間は主要国の国債市場で売りが広がっている。米30年債利回りは2007年以来の高水準まで上昇した。ドイツが今月発行した30年国債の利回りは15年ぶりの高水準となった。フランスの借り入れコストも2008年以来の高水準に達し、日本も過去最高に近い水準にある。

岡三証券の長谷川直也チーフ債券ストラテジストは「財政やインフレは、欧米と日本で共通しているテーマではある」と指摘し、日本の金利上昇が米国や欧州など「グローバルに影響する可能性というのはあると思う」と話した。

ベッセント氏は先週、長期国債の買い戻しを拡大する計画を発表し、米国債利回りの押し下げに動いた。その後の米国債相場上昇は長続きせず、利回りは翌日には再び上昇基調に戻った。

Shares, oil dip as US sanctions on Iran loom

FAST

LONDON/SYDNEY, Aug 24 : Global stocks slipped on Monday and oil prices eased as investors awaited details of threatened U.S. sanctions on Iran, while the Canadian dollar dipped as a trade war loomed with its southern neighbour. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is due to hold a press conference later on Monday to outline sanctions on Iran, which Washington says must relinquish its control over the vital Strait of Hormuz. Oil futures were down around 2 per cent ahead of the announcement as some oil traders took profits after big gains last week. The tech sector was on edge for Nvidia's results on Wednesday. Investors are aware how hard it will be for the chipmaker to meet sky-high expectations.

"The big news this week will be Nvidia earnings... The tone of that might drive sentiment into the Nasdaq (market)," said Nutshell Asset Management CIO Mark Ellis. Analysts are generally looking for quarterly revenue to almost double to around $92 billion. WARSH SPEECH MAY DISAPPOINT Market participants will also be hoping for some clarity on the outlook for U.S. interest rates when Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh speaks in Jackson Hole, Wyoming, on Friday, though his well-known aversion to forward guidance could lead to disappointment. "There are several reasons to expect to be underwhelmed," said Bruce Kasman, chief economist at JPMorgan, noting that past chairs have not wanted to front-run Fed decisions at the event. "Warsh will rather likely focus on aspects of his 'regime change' agenda," Kasman added. "As the Fed has already been moving toward shrinking the balance sheet, and the committee gave the balance sheet some attention in the July minutes, that might be the most likely topic for him to expound upon." Markets imply around a 40 per cent chance that the Fed will raise interest rates when it meets on September 16 and are fully priced for a move by December. The odds could change depending on what U.S. inflation figures show this week, with median forecasts for core inflation expected to hold at 3.3 per cent in July.  Warsh is sure to face questions about Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent's surprise announcement last week of at least a doubling in bond buybacks, aimed at restraining a rise in yields that was tightening financial conditions in the economy. His efforts have had little success so far, with 30-year yields at 5.2487 per cent, not far from the recent 19-year peak of 5.3371 per cent. U.S.-CANADIAN TRADE WAR European stocks gained 0.1 per cent, following declines across Asia including tech-heavy South Korean shares. On Wall Street, S&P 500 futures fell 0.2 per cent and Nasdaq futures were down 0.6 per cent. The Hong Kong-listed shares of Alibaba slid around 8.5 per cent after the Chinese e-commerce and cloud computing company launched a $10.2 billion share offer and investors worried about returns from its massive AI spending. fell more than 8 per cent after a record $79 billion shareholder-return plan disappointed investors who had expected a larger share of AI-fuelled cash flows. In currency markets, the dollar added 0.5 per cent against its Canadian counterpart to 1.3832 after Prime Minister Mark Carney said his country would respond to U.S. tariffs with levies of its own as trade talks broke down. Canada will impose tariffs on U.S. steel, dairy, appliances, agricultural equipment, pulp and paper products, and electronics, along with some products that the U.S. previously targeted in Canada. The dollar index was up 0.2 per cent to 98.981. The euro dipped 0.1 per cent to $1.1665 after rising 0.9 per cent last week, while the dollar gained 0.1 per cent to 159.13 yen. Gold firmed another 0.9 per cent to $4,643 an ounce, having climbed about 15 per cent for the month so far.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Ukraine wants peace but won't give in, Zelenskiy says on Independence Day
item.description: Flanked by British Prime Minister Andy Burnham and European Council President Antonio Costa, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy praised the resilience of the Ukrainian people during more than four years of war.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Flynn, Anna Pruchnicka
item.content:encoded: Ukraine wants peace but will not just surrender to Russia at any price, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said in a defiant speech on Monday to mark Independence Day, as foreign leaders pledged their support. Flanked by British Prime Minister Andy Burnham and European Council President Antonio Costa, Zelenskiy praised the resilience of the Ukrainian people during more than four years of war with Russia. "Ukraine absolutely wants peace, but it is not ready to simply surrender," Zelenskiy said, warning that Russia would not halt its aggression even if Ukraine ceded to its demands for more territory in the country's east. Wearing a traditional Ukrainian embroidered shirt, Zelenskiy thanked several foreign leaders for travelling to Kyiv to show their continued backing, on the 35th anniversary of Ukraine's break from the Soviet Union. Burnham, who took office last month, said his choice of Kyiv for his first foreign visit showed the importance he attached to assisting in Ukraine's defence. "We are with you in this struggle all the way, heart and soul," Burnham said, vowing to continue that support "despite Russia's outrageous threats to my country." Britain announced on Monday it would allow Kyiv access to classified technology to start production of European SCALP long-range cruise missiles in Ukraine, capable of carrying out strikes deep within Russia. In response, the Kremlin said the use of classified British technology would "add fuel to the fire" of their worsening relations, after it warned London last week there would be "consequences" for supplying drones to Kyiv. ALLIES TO HOLD MILITARY TALKS Burnham was scheduled to co-chair a virtual meeting of the "Coalition of the Willing" — a group of countries backing Ukraine — with French President Emmanuel Macron and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz. The leaders were expected to discuss Ukraine's request for more air defence systems to stop Russian ballistic missiles pounding Ukrainian cities. Zelenskiy said on Saturday that Ukraine's war effort was complicated by a [USN:L1N44K01P TEXT:"$27-billion defence funding gap"] this year. He also warned that Russian could escalate the conflict later this year by mobilizing some 300,000 additional troops after parliamentary elections in September. Paying tribute to Ukrainian people and soldiers defending Ukraine in the war, Zelenskiy called on allies to give it "everything" needed to stop the war. "We are not asking you to fight for us," he said. Hundreds of thousands of people have been killed, and swathes of Ukrainian territory have been laid waste, since Russia launched its full-scale invasion on February 24, 2022. U.S.-led peace talks to bring a lasting end to the war fell apart earlier this year as Ukraine refused Russian demands to cede more territory. Fighting continues along a 750-mile (1,200-km) front line and Ukraine has succeeded in bringing Russian advances overall to a virtual halt this year. Hovering in the sky above Kyiv, a squadron of aerial drones carried out a demonstration of the Ukrainian military technology, which has helped to keep Russian forces in check. Naval drones swept along the Dnipro river, while unnamed ground vehicles - some equipped with heavy machine guns - trundled in formation along one of the city's main commercial avenues. While praising the achievements of Ukraine's defence industry during the war, Zelenskiy called for an increase in cruise missile production to take the fight to Russia this winter. Exploiting Ukraine's critical shortage of anti-ballistic missiles, Russia has stepped up its campaign of air strikes at cities far from the front line this summer. Ukraine has also increased its long-range attacks on Russian refineries and logistics infrastructure, aimed at undermining Moscow's war effort. It hit four logistics hubs owned by Russia's second-largest online retailer Ozon in southern Russia in drone strikes on Monday, the company said. In a sombre moment, the Ukrainian leader rewarded fallen soldiers with state awards, which he presented to their mothers and family members. He also announced the return of 10 Ukrainian servicemen, who were previously listed as missing in action, as part of a special prisoner exchange with Russia. "We remember each and every one who remains in captivity," Zelenskiy said, promising to do everything possible to bring them home.

item.title: イラン、タンカー45隻をブラックリストに ホルムズ海峡通航規則違反
item.description: ［２４日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２４日　ロイター］ - イランは、ホルムズ海峡通航ルールに違反したとしてタンカー４５隻をブラックリストに登録したと発表し、これらの船舶と積荷を移し替える船舶に対しても措置を講じると警告した。

イランがホルムズ海峡の管理を目的に新設した機関、ペルシャ湾海峡庁（ＰＧＳＡ）が２３日遅くにＸに投稿した。通航ルールの内容は不明。イランはかねて、海峡通過にはイラン政府の許可が必要で、警備、その他のサービスの料金を支払うべきだと主張している。

ブラックリストに登録された船舶は罰金、拿捕（だほ）、積荷没収の対象となる可能性がある。対象は、超大型原油タンカー、液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）および液化石油ガス（ＬＰＧ）タンカー、クリーン石油製品船で、アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）のアブダビ国営石油会社（ＡＤＮＯＣ）傘下の会社、サウジアラビア国営海運会社バフリが所有する船舶のほか、クラーベネス・シップ・マネジメント、ストルト・タンカーズ、韓国の長錦商船（シノコー）が所有する船舶が含まれている。

対象船舶との洋上での積替えに関与した船舶もブラックリストに追加される可能性があるとした。

リストからの除外を求める船舶は、関連する説明を添えてイランの海事当局に要請を提出しなければならない。

FAST

BEIJING, Aug 24 : Alibaba officially rolled out its latest AI video generation-model Wan3.0 on Monday with enhanced capabilities after the Chinese internet giant launched a $10 billion share placement to fund rising AI spending. • The new model can generate 30-second videos from documents, spreadsheets, slides and web pages, Alibaba Cloud said in a post on the WeChat platform. • Alibaba said Wan3.0 had been used in short drama and film production, advertising and marketing, tourism promotion and music video creation since a public beta version was launched on August 6. • The release comes a day after Alibaba announced the share sale, the largest-ever primary follow-on offering by a Hong Kong-listed company, as it ramps up spending in the intensifying global AI race. • Alibaba last week reported a 75 per cent plunge in quarterly earnings from a year ago due to soaring AI-related capital expenditure.

Source: Reuters

item.title: プルデンシャル生命、自粛以降に不適切金銭受領－担当営業社員は死亡
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： プルデンシャル生命保険は24日、多摩支社に所属していた営業社員が複数の顧客に対し、架空の高金利預金など事実と異なる説明を行い、不適切に金銭を受領していた疑いがあると発表した。

発表によると、同営業社員による不適切な金銭の受領は同社が新規契約の販売自粛を開始した2月9日以降にも発生していた可能性がある。同営業社員は既に死亡しているという。被害件数や金額については同社などが調査中だが、全容把握に向けて情報を集めるために事案を公表することにした。

プルデンシャル生命は1月、100人超の社員や元社員が約500人の顧客から31億円に上る金額を不適切な手段で受け取っていたと発表した。2月9日から新規販売を90日間停止するとしたが、4月には11月5日まで180日間延長すると発表していた。

同社は、一連の不祥事を受けた新規契約の自粛期間中に、このような事案が発生したことについて、「大変重く受け止めており、改めて深くおわび申し上げる」としている。

item.title: 「ギグワークは福祉」、中国教授の発言が炎上 雇用不安映す
item.description: [香港 ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[香港 ２４日 ロイター] - 中国の著名な経済学教授が、単発・短期の仕事である「ギグワーク」を「福祉」の一形態と表現したことが国内世論の激しい反発を招いた。「柔軟な就業」という言葉がネット上で急速に広まり、雇用不安への根深い懸念が浮き彫りになった。

北京大学国家発展研究院の副院長で経済学教授の張丹丹氏は先週、人気経済番組「レッツ・トーク」で、ギグワーカーの社会保障について議論した際、労働経済学の観点では「柔軟性そのものが福祉の一形態だ」と発言した。

正規雇用者が勤務時間の柔軟性と引き換えに年金などの給付を受ける一方、柔軟な働き方をする人は社会保障が手薄になる代わりに、時間をより自由に使えると主張した。

交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）では先週末、張氏は単発・短期労働の厳しい現実を理解していないとの批判が相次いだ。

ある微博（ウェイボ）利用者は「専門家のこうした発言は、安定した仕事を持たない人々の傷口に塩を塗るに等しい」と投稿した。

別の利用者は、配達員や宅配員が絶え間ない重圧にさらされていると指摘。「彼らは毎日、休むこともなく、何を犠牲にしてでもプラットフォームのアルゴリズムと競争している。（柔軟な働き方は）本人の希望ではなく、まさに避けようのない選択だ」と訴えた。

中国では景気が減速し、安定したフルタイムの仕事を見つけにくくなっている中で、同氏の発言は多くの人々の神経を逆なでした。

シンクタンクの中国新就業形態研究センターは、常用のフルタイム契約を結んでいない就業者の数が２０２５年の２億８０００万人から今年は３億２０００万人に増えると推計している。これは中国の都市部労働力の約４４％に当たり、米国の全人口とほぼ同じ規模となる。

item.title: California cancels talks with Paramount over Warner Bros merger
item.description: California's Attorney General Rob Bonta canceled a meeting with Paramount Skydance representatives scheduled for Monday to begin settlement talks over the state's lawsuit seeking to block Paramount's proposed acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery , his office said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: California's Attorney General Rob Bonta canceled a meeting with Paramount Skydance (PSKY.O) representatives scheduled for Monday to begin settlement talks over the state's lawsuit seeking to block Paramount's proposed acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery (WBD.O) , his office said. Bonta accused Paramount of leaking details of a meeting held on Friday and acting in bad faith. "Not only did Paramount leak the alleged substance of settlement discussions, but they misrepresented these discussions, demonstrating a lack of good faith," Bonta said, adding his office met with Paramount on Friday. "As soon as Paramount stops playing games and engages sincerely, my office is happy to meet again," Bonta added. Paramount did not respond to Reuters requests for comment. The New York Times [USN:L6N44J066 TEXT:"reported"] on Saturday talks between the two parties were preliminary, and there was no assurance that they will lead to meaningful negotiations toward a settlement. Last month, California and 11 states [USN:L6N43G09L TEXT:"sued"] to block Paramount's $110 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, alleging the deal would lessen competition in film distribution and cable television, harming theaters and pay TV distributors. States including New York, Arizona and Minnesota argued the deal would harm theaters and television distributors, raise prices for consumers and make wages less competitive for workers. The Wall Street Journal reported earlier that Bonta planned to ask Paramount to divest some cable channels and commit to keeping its movie studio separate from Warner Bros. before he signs off on their merger, citing people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Iran threatens 45 tankers with fines, confiscation in Hormuz escalation
item.description: Iran said it had blacklisted 45 tankers that had broken its rules for crossing the Strait of Hormuz, and would take action against any vessels transferring loads with them, escalating its threats over the key waterway six months into the war.
item.dc:creator: Nidhi Verma, Florence Tan
item.content:encoded: Iran said it had blacklisted 45 tankers that had broken its rules for crossing the Strait of Hormuz, and would take action against any vessels transferring loads with them, escalating its threats over the key waterway six months into the war . The named vessels could be fined, detained and have their cargoes confiscated, according to an X post late on Sunday from the Persian Gulf Strait Authority, a new body set up by Iran to manage the strait. The warning was issued within days of the U.S. threatening Iran with [USN:L6N44H0E8 TEXT:""the toughest sanctions in history""], and Iran saying its response to any new U.S. threats would [USN:L8N44H1WH TEXT:"be "devastating""]. The restricted list includes very large crude carriers, liquefied natural gas and liquefied petroleum gas tankers, and clean product vessels, among others. Some of the named ships are owned by the United Arab Emirates' ADNOC Logistics and Shipping (ADNOC L&S), ADNOC's subsidiary Navig8 Tankers, and Saudi Arabia's national shipping carrier Bahri. Any vessels involved in ship-to-ship transfers with the named vessels could be added to the blacklist, the Iranian X post added. The post did not spell out what it meant by Iran's rules, but Tehran has in the past said ship-owners should get its clearance to transit the strait and said ships should pay for security and other services. The U.S. has also imposed a naval blockade against Iran-related shipping. The Gulf supplied about 20% of the world's daily crude oil and liquefied natural gas before the Iran conflict disrupted tanker traffic. U.S.-coordinated efforts to shuttle tankers quietly through the Strait of Hormuz to fill supertankers waiting just outside it are helping restore some of those export volumes. U.S. Secretary of Energy Chris Wright said on X on Friday that the "7-day average of oil leaving the Strait is over 8 million barrels a day. Make no mistake, thanks to the U.S. Navy, oil is flowing through the Strait of Hormuz." Ships owned by Klaveness Ship Management, Stolt Tankers and South Korea's Sinokor were also included on the blacklist. ADNOC declined to comment, while other shipping firms did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment. The Persian Gulf Strait Authority has said cargo owners should refer to an updated list of vessels deemed non-compliant for voyages relating to the Gulf. Ships seeking the removal of their names from the non-compliant vessels' list must submit a request with relevant explanations to Iran's maritime authorities, the post said. Below is the list of vessels appearing in the non-compliance list. item.title: ロシア通販大手オゾン、新たに拠点4カ所がドローン攻撃の標的に
item.description: [２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２４日 ロイター] - ロシア第２位のオンライン小売り大手オゾンは２４日、同国南部で所有する４カ所の物流拠点がウクライナによるドローン（無人機）攻撃の標的になったと発表した。２２日以降、標的となった施設の数は計６カ所となった。

このうち、ダゲスタン共和国マハチカラにある拠点では火災が発生し、操業を停止。数人が負傷したとの情報を確認しているという。

このニュースを受け、モスクワ証券取引所に上場するオゾンの株価は一時１２％下落した。

オゾンは、競合するワイルドベリーズに続き、ウクライナのドローン攻撃の標的となった。２２日に初めて攻撃を受け、サマラ州にある物流センターの業務を停止した。

item.title: Video appears to show 600 people abducted in Nigeria mosque attack, residents say
item.description: An armed group has posted a video showing what residents said were about 600 women, children and older people abducted in an attack on a mosque in Nigeria’s north-central Niger State last week.
item.dc:creator: Ahmed Kingimi, Hamza Ibrahim
item.content:encoded: An armed group has posted a video showing what residents said were about 600 women, children and older people abducted in [USN:L6N44J02S TEXT:"an attack"] on a mosque in Nigeria’s north-central Niger State last week. The video, posted on Sunday on Facebook and WhatsApp, showed large groups of people seated in a forested area surrounded by armed men. Several children could be heard crying in the background. Mass kidnappings for ransom have become common in parts of northwestern and north-central Nigeria, where heavily armed gangs frequently raid villages, schools and highways and hold them until paid large sums of money. Gunmen have increasingly [USN:L8N42C13S TEXT:"expanded south"], beyond hotspots in the north. 'WE HAVE IDENTIFIED OUR ELDERS, RELATIVES' The video surfaced two days after the latest kidnapping when gunmen attacked worshippers at the mosque in Dekara village during Friday prayers, taking people away in what residents said were simultaneous raids on several communities. In the video, a gunman speaking in Hausa addressed families of the captives and urged them to identify relatives among the people in the footage. "These are all your people. We are showing you this video so that you can identify your family members, your fathers, mothers, children and relatives," the gunman said. Reuters could not verify the exact date or the location where the video was filmed. However, no older version of the video was found posted online before August 23, 2026. Four residents said they were able to confirm the identities of some of those seized. "The people in the video are from Dekara. I've identified 13 people that I know," Ibrahim Abubakar told Reuters. Another resident, Abdulmutallib Muqaddas Dindi, said those who appeared in the video had been seized during the prayers. "We have identified our elders, relatives, and some of us have seen their wives and children in the video," he said. Police and state authorities did not respond to requests for comment on Monday. Police had earlier confirmed an attack on worshippers in the area but said they could not verify the number of people abducted. Resident Jamilu Ibrahim appealed to federal and state authorities to secure the release of the captives, pointing out the number of mothers with infants and children among those shown in the footage.

item.title: ピムコ、タームプレミアム高止まり予想－利回り上昇は債券投資の好機
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 投資家が長期国債を保有する際に求める上乗せ金利は、予想外の景気悪化がない限り、高止まりする可能性が高いと、パシフィック・インベストメント・マネジメント（PIMCO）はみている。利回りの上昇局面は債券を買う好機になるという。

米30年国債の利回りは約20年ぶりの水準まで上昇した。長期債のアンダーパフォームでイールドカーブがスティープ化し、タームプレミアムが上昇した。ピムコによると、欧州や英国、日本でも長期債利回りが上昇している。

ピムコで非伝統的運用戦略の最高投資責任者（CIO）を務めるマーク・サイドナー氏と、新興国市場ポートフォリオ運用責任者のプラモル・ダワン氏はリポートで、「引き続き債券は魅力的だとみており、利回りの上昇が続けば買い増しを検討する。利回り上昇によって、インカムやキャリーに加え、スティープ化したイールドカーブのロールダウン効果による収益機会も得られるためだ」と記した。

米国の公的債務残高が40兆ドル（約6357兆円）を突破し、借り入れコストが急上昇するなか、ベッセント米財務長官は先週、長期債の買い戻し計画を予想外に拡大し、市場の意表を突いた。ただ、市場の安堵は長続きせず、翌日には利回りが再び上昇した。世界的に財政負担や根強いインフレへの懸念がくすぶっている。

JPモルガン・チェースとPGIMは、米財務省の債務管理戦略における予測可能性が低下すれば、最終的に借り入れコストの上昇につながりかねないと警告している。資産家レイ・ダリオ氏は米国の債務危機がわずか3年後に迫っている可能性があると警告し、債券保有を減らすよう投資家に促した。

ピムコは、景気刺激を必要としていない経済への追加的な財政刺激策と、国債供給を巡る見通しの悪化が、利回りを一段と高いレンジに押し上げる主なリスクだと指摘した。

もっとも、米長期国債などの国債利回りは最近の上昇を経ても、過去の長期平均付近にあるにすぎないとピムコは指摘する。サイドナー、ダワン両氏は「現在の利回りが異例に高く見えるのは、世界金融危機後に人為的に抑え込まれていた金利と比べた場合だけだ」と記した。

item.title: 米韓、上陸訓練「双竜」を中止 イラン戦争で米軍派遣に制約
item.description: [ソウル ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ソウル ２４日 ロイター] - 韓国海兵隊は２４日、米国が韓国と９月に予定していた師団規模の合同上陸訓練「双竜訓練」を中止したと発表した。米側はイラン戦争の影響で訓練に投入できる部隊が限られることを理由に挙げた。

韓国海兵隊の報道官は記者会見で、米海兵隊から６月に正式に通知があったと明らかにした。報道官によると、両国は訓練再開に向けて緊密な協議を続けている。今後の中止を防ぐ措置や、失われた訓練機会を補う方法については明らかにしなかった。

これに先立ちトランプ米大統領は、２１日に終了した別の合同軍事演習「乙支フリーダムシールド」の規模を縮小するよう命じた。費用に加え、韓国がイラン戦争への参加を拒否したことを理由に挙げた。

item.title: Volkswagen workers criticise board's communication
item.description: Volkswagen employees have criticised what they called the management board's "disastrous external communication" as Europe's largest automaker considers further cost cuts.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) employees have criticised what they called the management board's "disastrous external communication" as Europe's largest automaker considers [USN:L8N44I0TG TEXT:"further cost cuts"], according to an internal works council article seen by Reuters on Monday. An online survey, conducted last week by Volkswagen's Group works council, found that employees and their families were "unsettled and frightened" by the board's public communication, the article said. Employees also raised concerns about job security, the future of early-retirement and severance programmes, and prospects for Volkswagen's plants in Emden, Hanover, Neckarsulm, Osnabrueck and Zwickau. In [USN:L8N44I0TG TEXT:"an internal company memo on Friday"], CEO Oliver Blume said four of those plants were not expected to reach competitive capacity utilisation in the 2030s, but stressed that there was no decision yet on specific plant closures. The workers criticised the lack of details on the future of these plants provided on Friday. Blume has rejected accusations of withholding information. "We continuously keep our colleagues and employee representatives informed about the status of the plans—through internal channels, but above all through direct personal dialogue," he said in July in an interview published on the company's website. Volkswagen is undergoing what is considered to be its largest-ever restructuring, possibly ranging from a further [USN:L8N42Y0CC TEXT:"50,000 job cuts"] to the [USN:L8N42Y1AR TEXT:"carve-out of some divisions"]. Blume will address employees at an extraordinary meeting in Wolfsburg on Tuesday and Thomas Schmall, head of components and a member of the management board, will speak in Braunschweig. The works council called the meetings in July after employee representatives criticised the management's communication over plans to improve the automaker's competitiveness.

item.title: 中国南西部で台風19号による洪水、5万人以上が避難 台湾も豪雨
item.description: 中国南西部の広西チワン族自治区で先週末、台風19号に伴う豪雨で洪水が発生し、数万人が避難を余儀なくされた。気象当局は今後数日もさらなる大雨に警戒するよう呼びかけている。 中国国営中央テレビ（CCTV）によると、洪水の影響で約5万4000人が避難した。 台風19号は南シナ海北西部のトンキン湾付近に数日間停滞し、広西チワン族自治区のほか近隣の海南省や広東省に大雨をもたらしている。 CCTVによると、中国南部の一部地域では26日にかけて大雨が続く見通しで、広西チワン族自治区と広東、海南、福建の各省では豪雨が予想されている。 一方、台湾南部の広い地域で24日、豪雨のため地方政府が官公庁や学校を休業・休校とした。今週末には台風が台湾北部に影響を及ぼす見通しとなっている。 台湾南部ではここ数日、低気圧が停滞し、豪雨が発生し、洪水を引き起こしている。

item.title: 独極右ＡｆＤ党首、州選挙で単独政権に自信 国政勝利の足がかりに
item.description:
Maria Martinez
[ベルリン ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Maria Martinez

[ベルリン ２３日 ロイター] - 独極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」のワイデル共同党首は２３日、９月６日に行われるザクセン・アンハルト州議会選で躍進し、将来の国政選挙で勝利する足がかりにすると意気込みを示した。

公共放送ＺＤＦとのインタビューで「われわれはザクセン・アンハルト州で政権を樹立する」と主張。単独の州政権を目指すとしている同州のＡｆＤ筆頭候補の発言からさらに踏み込み、単独政権樹立に必要な過半数を確保できるとの自信を示した。

インフラテスト・ディマップの世論調査によると、ＡｆＤの支持率は４１％で、メルツ首相率いる保守政党キリスト教民主同盟（ＣＤＵ）の２４％を大きく引き離している。

ＡｆＤは過去に一部地方選挙で高い支持を得たものの、他の主要政党が全て協力を拒否しているため、州政権にも連邦政権にも参画したことがない。

ワイデル氏は、ＡｆＤとの協力を拒むＣＤＵの姿勢は保守勢力を弱体化させており、いずれ自党を国政を運営する立場に押し上げると主張。「ＣＤＵは二度と連邦議会選で勝てないだろう」と述べた。

item.description: BEIJING, Aug 24 : Chinese smartphone maker Xiaomi on Monday unveiled a new version of its in-house Xring smartphone processor, betting that deeper control over key components will help strengthen its supply chain and reduce reliance on external chip suppliers.The introduction of Xring O3 comes a year after
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

Xiaomi launches new Xring chip, partners with TSMC for production, sources say

FILE PHOTO: Staff members stand near the company logo at a Xiaomi store in Shanghai, China November 1, 2021. Picture taken November 1, 2021. REUTERS/Aly Song/File Photo

FAST

BEIJING, Aug 24 : Chinese smartphone maker Xiaomi on Monday unveiled a new version of its in-house Xring smartphone processor, betting that deeper control over key components will help strengthen its supply chain and reduce reliance on external chip suppliers. The introduction of Xring O3 comes a year after Xiaomi launched its first proprietary smartphone processor, the Xring O1, marking the latest step in the world's third-largest smartphone vendor's push to join rivals such as Apple, Samsung Electronics and Huawei in developing its own chips. TSMC will manufacture the new chip using its 3-nanometre production technology, two people familiar with the matter said. One of the sources said the chip is expected to power Xiaomi's upcoming flagship folding phone, with a shipment target of 200,000 to 300,000 units.

The people declined to be identified because the plans are not public. Xiaomi and TSMC did not immediately respond to requests for comment on the chip's manufacturer, production technology or shipment targets. Smartphone processors, or system-on-chips (SoC), integrate computing, graphics, AI processing and imaging functions into a single component.  Xiaomi's chip push reflects a broader industry trend as device makers seek to differentiate products and lessen dependence on suppliers such as Qualcomm and MediaTek amid intensifying competition in premium smartphones. Xiaomi said during an earnings call last week that cumulative shipments of devices powered by the Xring O1, including smartphones, tablets and watches, had surpassed 1 million units since its launch. Xiaomi has sold about 150,000 smartphones based on the Xring O1 chip since its May 2025 launch, according to the sources.

item.title: ノルウェー、北極海石油・ガス開発は「主権」 ＥＵ方針にかかわらず継続へ
item.description:
Nora Buli Nerijus Adomaitis
［スタバンゲル（ノルウェー） ２４日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nora Buli　Nerijus Adomaitis

［スタバンゲル（ノルウェー）　　２４日　ロイター］ - ノルウェーのオースラン・エネルギー相は、欧州連合（ＥＵ）の方針に関係なく、バレンツ海での石油・ガス資源の開発を継続すると述べた。また、ノルウェーはもはや、再生可能エネルギー由来の余剰電力を欧州域内に提供する「グリーンバッテリー」ではないとの認識を示した。２４日に同国のスタバンゲルで開幕する半期に一度のエネルギー会議（ＯＮＳ）を前に、ロイターのインタビューで語った。

ＥＵは、環境保護の観点から北極圏での新規掘削の禁止を支持していたが、エネルギー安全保障への懸念から方針の見直しを検討している。

ロシアがウクライナの全面侵攻を開始した２０２２年以降、ノルウェーは欧州最大の天然ガス供給国となり、ＥＵと英国のガス需要の約３０％を満たしている。

２５年のノルウェーのガス生産量は過去最高に近い水準に、石油生産量は０９年以来の高水準だった。しかし公式予測によれば、新たな資源が発見・開発されない限り、生産量は２０３０年以降に急減する。

オースラン氏は、「現在の地政学・安全保障環境や資源状況を考慮すると、バレンツ海での活動継続はノルウェーと欧州双方の利益にかなうと信じている」と述べた。

ノルウェーは少なくとも２０３５年まで石油の生産と輸出を現在とほぼ同水準に維持することを目指しているが、そのためにはバレンツ海での生産が鍵になると指摘。「ノルウェーが欧州に対する石油・ガスの長期的な供給国であり続けるためには、北極圏をその議論の一部にしなければならない」と述べた。

すでにノルウェーはＥＵとの協議で、石油活動に開放されているバレンツ海の一部は北海のように氷結しておらず、原油流出などの環境面の影響を巡る懸念は限定的だとし、さらにロシアと国境を接する北部の雇用や定住の維持に役立っていると主張してきた。

オースラン氏は、こうした主張はＥＵ側に聞き入れられつつあると考えているが、仮にＥＵが引き続き凍結を支持したとしても、バレンツ海での資源開発は主権的権利だとした。

国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）のビロル事務局長も、エネルギー安保を支えるため、北極圏での新規の石油・ガス開発に対する反対姿勢を再考するようＥＵに促している。

オースラン氏は、北極圏の石油はどのみち世界市場で販売されるし、ガスはハンメルフェスト近郊にあるエクイノールのプラントから液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）として世界中に輸出できると指摘した。

エクイノールのアンダース・オペダル最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）も、バレンツ海産の石油とＬＮＧは、ＥＵに拒絶された場合でも世界のどこへでも輸送できるとし、「それによって損害を被るのは実際のところ欧州の安全保障だけだ。われわれには柔軟性がある」とロイターに語った。

＜グリーンバッテリーは「誤った考え」＞

石油とガスに加え、ノルウェーはほとんどの年において、水力発電による余剰電力を越境送電ケーブルを通じて欧州に輸出。「欧州のグリーンバッテリー」を自称してきた。

オースラン氏は、ノルウェー単独で欧州電力市場の需給バランスを取ることができず、今や時代遅れで「誤った考え」だと指摘した。

背景には、国内の反発がある。英国やドイツを含む新たな送電網の建設などにより、電力システムとの統合が深まったことで、大陸欧州の価格変動の影響を受けやすくなった。

オースラン氏は、ノルウェーは新たな送電線を建設しないが、欧州との強力な電力部門の協力には引き続き取り組むと述べたが、他の欧州諸国に対し、脱火力発電や脱原発によって脆弱になった電力供給の強化を求めた。「そうすることで価格が下がり、各国間の電力融通における相互性も高まる」とし、「未来は非常に強力で統合されたシステムを持つことにある」と語った。

item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： ローソンは24日、コメ価格が下落していることを受けて、おにぎりを値下げすると明らかにした。手巻きおにぎりが対象で、値段を一律で10円引き下げる。

同社の広報担当者によると、価格改定は9月29日から。手巻きおにぎりの「 熟成紀州南高梅」は税込み194円から184円に、「シーチキンマヨネーズ」は同181円から171円にそれぞれ値下げする。

農林水産省によると、8月10日からの1週間にスーパーで販売されたコメ5キロ当たりの全国平均価格は、税込みで3191円だった。4000円を超えて推移していた販売価格は、26年1月以降、下落基調に転じた。

原材料の高騰や円安などによるコスト上昇を受けて、値上げする企業が相次ぐ中、あえて値下げに動く企業も一部で見られる。くら寿司は最低価格115円で提供していたすしメニューの一部について、110円に値下げすると20日に発表していた。

ローソンの広報担当者は、求めやすい価格で商品を提供することで、「結果として米の消費拡大につなげて行きたい」とも語った。

item.title: Ukraine targets Ozon in widening attacks on Russian online retailers
item.description: Kyiv had until last week focused on Ozon's rival, Wildberries, in attacks on the e-commerce sector — one of the fastest-growing parts of the Russian economy.
item.dc:creator: Gleb Bryanski
item.content:encoded: Ukraine has targeted four logistics hubs owned by Russia's second-largest online retailer Ozon, widening a campaign of drone strikes on Russian e-commerce companies intended to inflict more damage on the war-battered economy. Ozon's shares tumbled on Monday after it reported the strikes in southern Russia, which brought to six the number of its facilities targeted in the last three days. Kyiv had until last week focused on Ozon's rival, [USN:L1N4440DQ TEXT:"Wildberries"], in attacks on the e-commerce sector — one of the fastest-growing parts of the Russian economy, which is otherwise close to stagnation after 4-1/2 years of war in Ukraine . Ozon said in a statement that a logistics hub in Makhachkala in Dagestan was on fire and had halted operations after a drone attack, adding: "According to preliminary information, several people were injured." A fire also broke out at an Ozon logistics hub in the town of Enem on the outskirts of the city of Krasnodar, and workers were evacuated from warehouses in Adygeysk, in the Adygeya region, and in Nevinnomyssk in the Stavropol region although neither facility was damaged, it said. Work at an Ozon logistics centre in the Samara region was halted on Saturday after it was hit in a drone strike, and the company said work had been halted at its logistics centre in the [USN:L1N44K01C TEXT:"Orenburg region"], from which over 300 people were evacuated. Shares in Ozon fell by almost 30% on the Moscow Exchange on Monday and shares in its major shareholder, private equity firm AFK Sistema, fell over 13%. Ozon shares had risen nearly 300% since the market turmoil that followed the start of the war in Ukraine in 2022, making Ozon one of Russia's best-performing stocks until the attacks. Kyiv has been attacking Wildberries warehouses on the grounds that they are part of infrastructure underpinning Russia's war in Ukraine. The strikes are part of a wider campaign to disrupt Russia's economic infrastructure, choke off war financing and bring the realities of the conflict home to ordinary Russians as [USN:L1N44I0IA TEXT:"Moscow continues to pound"] cities and infrastructure across Ukraine. As part of the campaign, attacks on Russian oil refineries have caused [USN:L1N44H0AG TEXT:"fuel shortages"] and forced motorists in Moscow to queue for hours for petrol. WILDBERRIES SAYS 'WE KEEP ON WORKING' Financial analysts said that unlike privately owned Wildberries, which has the backing of its partner, state-owned bank VTB, Ozon's main shareholder AFK Sistema has a large debt and is unlikely to provide substantial support for the retailer. In remarks before the latest attacks on Ozon, Russian President Vladimir Putin promised [USN:L8N44G0XL TEXT:"state help"] in the restoration of warehouses "at a new technological level" and asked the government to design a special program to help the sector. The Finance Ministry said on Monday it had prepared measures to support Wildberries and small businesses operating on its platform whose goods have been damaged in attacks. The measures included tax breaks for up to one year. Russia's [USN:L8N4470DF TEXT:"central bank"] has also advised creditors to support businesses affected by attacks on logistics centres and warehouses. "We keep on working," said Wildberries owner Tatyana Kim, Russia's richest businesswoman, welcoming the tax breaks. Neither the ministry nor the company disclosed the value of the support package. Ozon, which grew from an online bookstore, was once a favourite among foreign investors and had its depositary receipts listed on Nasdaq until 2023. The company raised $1 billion in an initial public offering in 2020. It is now listed on the Moscow Exchange. Before the war, international investors included U.S.-based BlackRock, which said it held no Ozon shares in 2023. Ozon does not disclose the names of its investors, but Norway's sovereign wealth fund, the world's largest, reported ownership of 0.23% of shares in Ozon as well as over 1% of shares in Sistema last June. The European Union imposed sanctions on Ozon and Wildberries' financial units on July 24. Ozon said its unit does not operate outside Russia and does not have any assets, which could be hit by Western sanctions.
